text.tspan: Search finds the path s → a → b → t in Gf. Room on each edge: s→a = 5, a→b = 8, b→t = 10
Bottleneck = min(5, 8, 10) = 5 → push 5 units along the whole path
Flow network: f(s,a) 0 → 5 FULL, f(a,b) 0 → 5, f(b,t) 0 → 5
Residual graph: every path edge loses 5 of room; backward edges a→s, b→a, t→b gain 5. Full now, so it leaves Gf: s→a

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Orange (bold) = augmenting path, green = carries flow, red = full, dashed violet = backward (undo) edge in Gf
